The tibial footprint of the anterior cruciate is conventionally described as of the order of 17 mm front to back and 11 mm across, which is broader than its femoral attachment.
The posterior cruciate attachment is not on the spine but behind and below it, in a depression on the posterior surface of the tibia, conventionally described as about 1 cm below the joint line.
